semantics.global: Submatrix of the full inverse using all eight bins; all other fitted coordinates marginalized.
semantics.bin_only: Only this bin likelihood plus priors once; invert all local coordinates before selecting cosmology and linear biases.
semantics.rho: C_ij / sqrt(C_ii C_jj), never normalized Fisher entries.
semantics.not_additive: The bin-only matrices include the cosmology prior each time and must not be summed.
